tokens.name: grey-900
tokens.usage: Black / ink. All body and headline text on light grounds (15:1 on white). Ground for chapter dividers and dark slides. Part of the 60% neutral share.

tokens.name: grey-700
tokens.usage: Body copy on slides (softer than the ink titles, 10:1 on white), eyebrows and card / takeaway labels, takeaway text, table values.

tokens.name: grey-500
tokens.usage: Footnotes, sources, base sizes (n =), quote attributions and contact details on white, Grey 10 and Beige (≥5.2:1). Never for headlines or body copy.

tokens.name: grey-300
tokens.usage: Page numbers on the contents slide and placeholder outlines; 3.2:1 on white, so only for bold or 32px+ text. Also axis lines and inactive markers. No longer used for subtitles or labels (those are blue eyebrows).

tokens.name: chapter-number
tokens.usage: The chapter number before the chapter title on gradient chapter slides (approved template). Decorative, large text only.

tokens.name: grey-50
tokens.usage: Hairline rules, table dividers and chart gridlines on white. Decorative only.

tokens.name: grey-25
tokens.usage: Table zebra rows and empty chart tracks on white.

tokens.name: grey-10
tokens.usage: Quiet ground for boxed content, sources panels and image placeholders. Neutral share.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Default slide and page ground; the bulk of the 60% neutral share. Text on dark grounds (grey-900, blue-100, blue-200).

tokens.name: beige
tokens.usage: Warm ground for quote, testimonial and human-story slides. Neutral share; ink reads 15:1 on it.

tokens.name: blue-200
tokens.usage: Pressed state, deep accents, chart emphasis on light grounds. White text 10.7:1 on it.

tokens.name: blue-100
tokens.usage: Appinio Blue — the core brand colour and the 25% share. Highlighted words in headlines on light grounds, NPS score pills, the key number on a stat slide, primary actions. White text 7:1 on it. Not for bullets, borders or every bar.

tokens.name: blue-75
tokens.usage: Hover on blue-100 fills. White text is 4.45:1 on it — just below AA for small text; keep labels ≥19px bold or 24px.

tokens.name: blue-50
tokens.usage: Strong borders and secondary marks next to blue-100. Not a text colour on white.

tokens.name: blue-25
tokens.usage: Highlighted words in headlines on dark grounds (10.8:1 on grey-900), per the brand cheat sheet.

tokens.name: blue-10
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for one callout or info panel per slide. Neutral share; blue-100 text reads 5.9:1 on it.

tokens.name: green-100
tokens.usage: Secondary accent (15% share, shared with orange): illustration, shapes, one accent per slide. 2.5:1 on white — never text or a text ground.

tokens.name: green-75
tokens.usage: Lighter green accent for shapes and illustration.

tokens.name: green-50
tokens.usage: Soft green fills behind ink text.

tokens.name: green-10
tokens.usage: Faint green ground behind ink text.

tokens.name: orange-100
tokens.usage: Secondary accent (15% share, shared with green). 3.0:1 on white — never body text; ok for 24px+ bold numerals only.

tokens.name: orange-75
tokens.usage: Lighter orange accent for shapes and illustration.

tokens.name: orange-50
tokens.usage: Soft orange fills behind ink text.

tokens.name: orange-10
tokens.usage: Faint orange ground behind ink text.

styles.name: slide-cover-title
styles.usage: Cover title only, white on the cover gradient, max two lines.

styles.name: slide-big-number
styles.usage: Big numbers (up to three per slide) and the Key Findings title (ExtraBold there).

styles.name: slide-display
styles.usage: Chapter titles on gradients and the two-line statement slide.

styles.name: slide-quote
styles.usage: Quote slides, next to the speaker's photo.
styles.sample: “When market research is fast, it becomes a habit.”

styles.name: slide-title-lg
styles.usage: A ‘big and bold’ title that carries the slide’s message, and the Agenda title.
styles.sample: Big and bold title to say something important

styles.name: slide-title
styles.usage: Standard content slide title, top-left, in ink, under its eyebrow. Bold (not ExtraBold) with slight negative tracking for a softer look.

styles.name: slide-eyebrow
styles.usage: Small heading ABOVE the slide title (question type, cut or section, e.g. MATRIX / GRID · AGE SPLITS) and every card / takeaway label, in grey-700 (dark grey), uppercase, 2px tracking.

styles.name: slide-agenda
styles.usage: Agenda and contents lines; the number before each in chapter-number grey.

styles.name: slide-lead
styles.usage: Chapter intro text, big-number descriptions and point headings.
styles.sample: This is reserved for an intro text into the chapter.

styles.name: slide-body
styles.usage: All body copy and bullets, in grey-700 (#39404C). Regular — bold is for titles and numbers only.
styles.sample: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit.

styles.name: slide-label
styles.usage: Label above a big number, fact or chart callout — same style as slide-eyebrow, in grey-700.

styles.name: slide-footnote
styles.usage: Legend, base (n =) and source in the footer row beside the logo, in grey-500. The template's 19–20px is raised to the 24px slide minimum.
